messages:
anya: quick sketch: avoid big active/active rewrite by adding a tiny residency decision layer in the edge proxy. control-plane sets per-tenant region hint.
drew: what header name? X-Resident-Region?
anya: yes. also X-Residency-Policy (strict|preferred|allow-fallback) and X-Cache-Version for cache coordination.
kai: how do writes work? if proxy routes to non-resident exec, do we swap leases? expensive.
anya: two modes: (A) proxy-prefer: route to resident when healthy, else fallback; runtime lease behaviour unchanged. (B) escrow-intent: resident runtime issues a short-lived token that allows another region to execute without swapping leases each time.
rav: escrow reduces lease churn but needs a token protocol and audit logging. which do we roll out first?
anya: rollout plan: phase0 telemetry-only (proxy logs decisions), phase1 preferred enforcement + cache-version + billing tags, phase2 strict + escrow experiment.
drew: telemetry to capture: percent resident vs fallback, latency delta, KV hit-rate by tenant, lease-swap count.
kai: cache concerns: add tenant cache-version header and a soft-evict marker so resident nodes mark items stale instead of immediate purge.
rav: compliance: emit an audit event whenever request crosses residency boundary with tenant id + route-trace-id. ops-bot: residency.enforce=false in staging; tests/residency/ covers header + cache-version.
anya: I'll open a tiny PR with header schema, decision matrix, and dashboard mock. please review when posted.
drew: I'll check billing tags.
kai: I'll prototype cache-version handling.
rav: I'll draft the compliance event schema and emergency override runbook.
anya: thanks — moving action items into the RFC follow-up.
